title: Recycling in Our Town
text:
Recycling helps our planet. People put paper, glass and plastic into different bins. In our town, there are five big bins in every park. Recycling saves trees and water.

Some families also compost food waste. Food waste becomes soil for plants in the garden. My uncle has a small compost box at the back of his house. He says the soil is very good for flowers.

questions.text: How many big bins are there in every park?
What does food waste become in the compost box?
Why does the uncle keep a compost box?
options: He wants to help plants grow

questions.text: What can we infer about the people in this town?
options: They throw away all their paper

vocabulary.definition: the process of using old materials to make new products
large containers used to store rubbish
a mixture of food waste that helps plants grow
the top layer of earth where plants grow

paragraph_translations: Recykling pomaga naszej planecie. Ludzie wrzucają papier, szkło i plastik do różnych pojemników. W naszym mieście w każdym parku są pięć dużych pojemników. Recykling oszczędza drzewa i wodę.

Niektóre rodziny także kompostują resztki jedzenia. Resztki jedzenia zamieniają się w glebę dla roślin w ogrodzie. Mój wujek ma mały pojemnik na kompost za domem. Mówi, że ziemia jest bardzo dobra dla kwiatów.
